The '''Low Altitude Assault Transport/stealth''', or '''LAAT/s''', was a stealth version of the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]]. They were used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Unlike most versions of the LAAT, the LAAT/s had a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].

==History==
During the Clone Wars, a group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] and Republic agents traveled to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-occupied [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]] in an LAAT/s. The craft was able to avoid detection by the orbiting Separatist [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], but crash-landed on the planet, due to unforeseen weather conditions. The wrecked transport was then attacked by an escaped [[Roggwart/Legends|roggwart]], although the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] were able to kill it. They then unloaded all their equipment from the transport and one of the commandos then blew it up, to prevent the Separatists from learning any classified information from it.
